author: Zephyr I
title: LN-gated ConvLSTM + 1-head Attn (64ch) with global grad clipping (Adam)
abstract: Keep the SOTA LN-gated ConvLSTM (64ch) with single-head attention and default PG; change only the optimizer to add global gradient clipping (norm=1.0) before Adam to test stability and performance.
